description: A Product Manager - Web and Mobile is responsible for overseeing the full development lifecycle of web and mobile solutions. The role involves creating detailed use cases, aligning business requirements, and understanding customer needs. The individual also shapes the go-to-market strategies and drives customer engagement and retention initiatives to ensure the success of the product
